title: Eleven Signs and One Door
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：sign　|　正文 309 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sign 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There were eleven ① signs on the way down to the pump room, and not one of them was in a language anybody in the valley spoke. My father said the ② sign you cannot read is worse than no sign, because it makes a place look looked-after, and a place that looks looked-after is not checked.

The first ③ sign of trouble, as he told it, was not a smell or a sound but the fact that the water in the sump had gone still. He said there had been a ④ sign of it for eleven days and nobody had read it, including him.

In 1998 the company put up new ⑤ signs in three languages, with pictures of a man falling, and my father said the pictures were better than the words and eleven years too late. There was ⑥ no sign of the old ones anywhere, which he said was the point. He had been deaf in one ear since 1974 and used ⑦ sign language with the men, badly, and they understood him perfectly.

On the door of the pump room somebody had painted a ⑧ sign that was neither a word nor a picture: three strokes, in red, which my father said meant 'go back' in every language, and which nobody had ever obeyed. He gave a ⑨ sign with his hand — two fingers, once, in 1974 — and eleven men turned round and walked out, and he said afterwards that he had no idea why they did.

The pump room was sealed in 2003. He never knew his ⑩ star sign and said he did not need one, having been told all his life what he was like. Eleven years after the last of the company's notices came down, my mother painted three words above our back door, and there is still no sign on the door of the pump room.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 标志；标牌；告示牌
B. n. 迹象；征兆；预兆
C. n. 手势；示意动作
E. n. 星座；属相（star sign）
F. 固定搭配：a sign of ... ……的迹象／征兆
G. 固定搭配：sign language 手语
H. 固定搭配：no sign of ... 没有……的踪迹／痕迹

items.q: There were eleven signs on the way down
there had been a sign of it for eleven days
the company put up new signs
There was no sign of the old ones
used sign language with the men
He gave a sign with his hand
He never knew his star sign

answers.why: signs 意为“标牌、告示牌”，通往泵房的路上有十一块，没有一块用的是山谷里的人看得懂的语言。
the sign 意为“标牌”，读不懂的标牌比没有标牌更糟。
a sign of ... 意为“……的迹象”，出事的第一个迹象不是气味也不是声音。
a sign 意为“征兆、预兆”，他说十一天来一直有征兆，而谁也没有读懂，包括他自己。
signs 意为“标牌”，1998 年公司立了三种文字的新标牌，还配了图画。
no sign of ... 意为“没有……的踪迹”，旧标牌一张也找不到了。
sign language 意为“手语”，他一只耳朵失聪，就跟工人们打手语。
a sign 意为“符号、记号”，泵房门上那三道红杠不是字也不是画。
a sign 意为“手势、示意动作”，1974 年他用手比了两根手指，十一个人就转身走了出去。
star sign 意为“星座”，他从不知道自己的星座，说不需要。

他从 1974 年起一只耳朵失聪，就用手语跟工人们交流。（sign language）
